title: GAIA Twin-Scale Value Transfer v1
description: A value flow across an adjacent boundary of the world-model twin hierarchy galactic/space twin <-> world economic twin (the economic spine) <-> human digital twin (Binding 2). Value flows are the exchange dynamics of the scale stack. Invariant IC-1: value is CONSERVED across a twin-scale aggregation. A cross-scale flow that creates value out of nothing (parent value exceeds the sum of children net of receipted sources/sinks) is REJECTED (tooth T2-CONSERVE).

scale_stack.description: The declared world-model twin hierarchy, in outer-to-inner order. MUST be exactly [galactic_space_twin, world_economic_twin, human_digital_twin].

parent.description: The coarser (outer) scale of this transfer.

children.description: The finer (inner) scale constituents whose values aggregate into the parent.

declared_sources.description: Receipted injections into the aggregate (a source outside the child set). Unreceipted creation is not permitted.

declared_sinks.description: Receipted removals from the aggregate (a sink outside the child set).

conservation.description: The IC-1 conservation rule. parent.value == sum(children.value) + sum(declared_sinks.amount) - sum(declared_sources.amount), within tolerance.
